settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
Magnetic phone ring holder, improve your phone stand experience

This magnetic phone ring holder is stylish, practical and convenient, and can easily stabilize your iPhone. Lumpia magsafe phone grip is very suitable for daily use, providing strong magnetic attraction and can be used as a 360° rotating holder, which is an ideal support choice for daily mobile phone use.

Compatible with MagSafe and magnetic mobile phone cases

This ring holder stand is seamlessly compatible with all iPhones and magnetic mobile phone cases that support MagSafe, and is stable and reliable to use. Whether you are walking, playing games or taking selfies, it can keep your phone firmly in place.

360° rotating ring

You can adjust the angle of the magnetic ring as needed. It can be operated as a stable phone holder with one hand, or it can be flipped to place the phone upright or diagonally, and enjoy the convenience of hands-free mobile phone anytime, anywhere.

Slim and lightweight, portable design

This magnetic ring for phone combines fashionable design with practical functions. It will not increase the size of the mobile phone, and it is easy to carry in a pocket or bag, providing convenience for daily travel.

Lanyard for added security

The included lanyard gives you peace of mind when carrying your phone, allowing you to keep your phone firmly in hand while traveling, commuting or outdoor activities.

Durable and stylish construction

This magnetic phone ring holder is carefully crafted with high-quality materials to last, while also complementing your phone's design with an elegant look.Why choose our magnetic phone ring holder and stand?Whether you are a busy professional, student or content creator, this magnetic phone grip provides a secure grip, hands-free convenience and a versatile stand - all in one stylish package. settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.content: Shipping typically takes 5-7 business days within the United States. For international orders, shipping can take 10-15 business days, depending on the destination and customs processing times. You will receive a tracking number once your order has shipped so you can monitor its progress.

settings.heading: Does my piece come in any packaging?
settings.content: Yes, all our skincare products come in protective and aesthetically pleasing packaging to ensure they arrive in perfect condition. Each product is securely wrapped, and we use eco-friendly materials whenever possible. Additionally, many of our products come in recyclable containers to support sustainability.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.content: We accept a variety of payment methods to make your shopping experience convenient. These include credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and, in some regions, alternative payment methods such as Apple Pay or Google Pay. Rest assured, your payment information is secure and protected during the checkout process.
